fixtureCleanup.verificationBasis: Original runner checked exact fixture ownership and successful cleanup API results; Report absence was reread. This diagnosis made no additional hosted calls.

localReproduction.environment: Native headless Chromium; loopback HTTP server only; no hosted URLs, accounts, credentials or mutations
localReproduction.seam: Exact current hosted UX newContext closure with unchanged mutation guard, forwardWithoutRedirects and safeFailure; forwarding wrapper captures local terminal outcomes without changing control flow

timingEvidence.failureWindow: After final functional step asserted an empty boundaryFailures set and before cleanup copied that set

rankedExplanations: An in-flight Worker read canceled by context close is locally reproducible, but cannot be assigned as the original cause.
A genuine late transport failure during Supervisor background work or cleanup produces the same generic code. All awaited fixture cleanup operations nevertheless passed.
A deliberate mutation or redirect guard rejection normally retains a specific safe code; an unrelated parsing or forwarding runtime exception remains possible.

requiredSeparateRerun.interpretation: A passing unchanged-source rerun establishes a separate clean gate, not the original cause.

releaseTreatment: Retain the original failed proof and this hash-bound explanation. Classify its sole late generic request failure as an unresolved historical verifier/transport risk, not unperformed fixture cleanup. Never excuse unknown POST outcomes, additional cleanup failures, guard violations, or missing cleanup verification.
futureVerifierRefinement: Track bounded in-flight guarded-route settlement before closing a context; retain every mutation guard and timeout/uncertain-POST failure. Add only sanitized method, allowlisted route category, guard/fetch/fulfill phase and context-closing state. Do not remove routes or suppress closed-context exceptions.
limitation: The focused reproduction demonstrates two distinct causes of the same saved symptom. It does not prove the original hosted request, route, method or cause.
